# bevy_copilot (BRP CLI)

Drive a running Bevy app from Bash. Every leaf command prints its result as JSON on stdout and exits 0, or prints the error on stderr and exits 1 (clap usage errors exit 2). Details per leaf live in `reference/<group>.md`; read those on demand. Three more reference docs are curated, not generated: `reference/conventions.md` (argument shapes and type paths), `reference/recipes.md` (end-to-end workflows with example outputs), and `reference/troubleshooting.md` (errors, exit codes, wire gotchas).

## Prerequisites

- Use the current `bevy_copilot` executable (`command -v bevy_copilot`). Run `bevy_copilot skills install --dir .agents/skills --check true` from the project root to verify that the executable matches this installation; adjust `--dir` and `--name` for a custom installation. A matching version label alone does not identify a build.
- The supported app protocol is Bevy 0.19 BRP: `bevy_remote`'s `RemotePlugin` + `RemoteHttpPlugin` (default `http://127.0.0.1:15702/`). Only reflect-registered types are visible — an app opts types in with `.register_type::<T>()`.
- `brp extras *` subcommands additionally need the app to run `bevy_copilot_extras`' `BrpExtrasPlugin`; they self-gate on `rpc.discover` and fail informatively otherwise.

## Connection and global flags

Read the host project's `AGENTS.md` for endpoint and mutation scope. Verify `status.reachable` on the intended peer before acting; a successful status exit code alone does not prove connectivity. BRP mutations bypass game input replication, so use the host's permitted isolated/solo workflow and never mutate peers participating in a determinism verification run.

`--host <HOST>` (env `BEVY_BRP_HOST`, default `127.0.0.1`), `--port <PORT>` (env `BEVY_BRP_PORT`, default `15702`), `--compact <true|false>` (single-line JSON). All three are global: they parse anywhere in the command path. To inspect several apps at once, run each on its own port and pick per call with `--port`.

## Output rules

- Results over 64 KiB spill to `<temp dir>/.bevy_copilot/brp_spill_*.json`; stdout gets `{spilled, path, bytes, preview}` — read the spill file for the payload.
- Watch subcommands stream JSONL (one compact frame per line); ALWAYS bound them with `--frames <N>` and/or `--max-ms <MS>`.
- Debug session state does not persist across CLI invocations (see `reference/debug.md`).
- Mutating subcommands (`brp world spawn-entity`, `brp world insert-components`, `brp world mutate-*`, `brp world remove-*`, `brp world despawn-entity`, `brp world trigger-event`, `brp world write-message`) change the live app immediately; there is no undo except `brp debug experiment` sessions. Prefer read-only calls unless a change is intended.

Bare `bevy_copilot` prints the top-level commands; every group level prints its own help (`bevy_copilot brp --help`, `bevy_copilot brp world --help`); `bevy_copilot <path> --help` prints a leaf's flags.

## Argument conventions

- Entities are positional u64 ids; types are fully-qualified paths (`my_game::Health`), and only reflect-registered types exist over BRP.
- Nested payloads are JSON flags: `--components '{"my_game::Health": {"value": 100.0}}'`, `query --data/--filter`, `execute --params`. Booleans take explicit `true|false`; string lists are comma-delimited.
- The full grammar plus how to discover type paths: `reference/conventions.md`.

## Common tasks

| Task | Where to start |
| ---- | -------------- |
| Probe connectivity | `status` |
| Find entities / read / change values | `brp world query`, `get-components`, `mutate-components` |
| Spawn / despawn | `brp world spawn-entity` / `despawn-entity` |
| React to changes | `brp watch *` (always bounded) |
| Screenshot / synthetic input | `brp extras screenshot`, `send-keys`, `click-mouse` |
| App-specific methods | `brp rpc discover` + `brp rpc execute` |
| QA record / replay / checkpoint | `brp debug record` / `replay` / `checkpoint` |
| Performance | `brp extras get-diagnostics`, `brp debug stress` |

Step-by-step versions with example outputs: `reference/recipes.md`.

## Exit codes

| Situation | Output | Code |
| --------- | ------ | ---- |
| Bare invocation / bare group | Help on stdout | 0 |
| Leaf success | JSON on stdout | 0 |
| Runtime / BRP error | Message on stderr | 1 |
| clap usage error | Usage on stderr | 2 |

## Environment and state

`BEVY_BRP_HOST` / `BEVY_BRP_PORT` override the endpoint (flags beat env vars). The state dir — `<temp dir>/.bevy_copilot`, its exact path in the `status` output — holds `journal.jsonl`, `checkpoints/<name>.json`, and `brp_spill_*.json`. Errors, wire gotchas (NaN arrives as null, replay remaps entity ids), and the debug one-shot limitation: `reference/troubleshooting.md`.

## Command index

### Bridge — `reference/bridge.md`

- `status` — Print bridge status as JSON: static config plus a connectivity probe (`--probe false` for the offline static payload)

### World — `reference/world.md`

- `brp world spawn-entity` — Spawn a new Bevy entity with the given components
- `brp world get-components` — Fetch specific components of an entity by type path
- `brp world query` — Query entities by component selection and optional filter
- `brp world despawn-entity` — Despawn an entity and its children
- `brp world insert-components` — Insert or overwrite components on an existing entity
- `brp world remove-components` — Remove components (by type path) from an entity
- `brp world mutate-components` — Mutate a single field of one component on an entity
- `brp world reparent-entities` — Reparent entities under a new parent (omit parent to unparent)
- `brp world list-components` — List component type paths for one entity or the whole world
- `brp world get-resources` — Fetch the value of a Bevy resource by type path
- `brp world insert-resources` — Insert or overwrite a resource value by type path
- `brp world remove-resources` — Remove a resource by type path
- `brp world mutate-resources` — Mutate a single field of a resource
- `brp world list-resources` — List every resource type path in the world
- `brp world trigger-event` — Trigger a Bevy Event by type path with an optional value
- `brp world write-message` — Write a Bevy Message by type path with an optional value

### Registry — `reference/registry.md`

- `brp registry schema` — Fetch the Bevy type-registry schema (optionally crate-filtered)

### Schedule — `reference/schedule.md`

- `brp schedule list` — List the app's Bevy schedules
- `brp schedule graph` — Fetch a schedule's system graph as structured system-graph data

### RPC — `reference/rpc.md`

- `brp rpc discover` — List every JSON-RPC method the remote BRP endpoint exposes
- `brp rpc execute` — Call any BRP method advertised by rpc.discover with verbatim JSON params

### Watch — `reference/watch.md`

- `brp watch get-components` — Watch a specific entity's components, streaming each frame as JSONL
- `brp watch list-components` — Watch component list changes for one entity or the world, streaming JSONL
- `brp watch observe` — Watch an entity via world.observe, streaming each frame as JSONL

### Extras — `reference/extras.md`

- `brp extras screenshot` — Capture a screenshot of the Bevy app's primary window
- `brp extras record` — Record the Bevy app's primary window as a PNG frame sequence
- `brp extras shutdown` — Shut down the Bevy app
- `brp extras get-diagnostics` — Fetch frame diagnostics from the Bevy app
- `brp extras set-window-title` — Set the Bevy app's primary window title
- `brp extras send-keys` — Send keyboard key presses to the Bevy app
- `brp extras type-text` — Type a text string into the Bevy app
- `brp extras click-mouse` — Click a mouse button in the Bevy app
- `brp extras double-click-mouse` — Double-click a mouse button in the Bevy app
- `brp extras send-mouse-button` — Press and hold a mouse button for a duration in the Bevy app
- `brp extras move-mouse` — Move the mouse cursor to a position in the Bevy app
- `brp extras drag-mouse` — Drag the mouse with smooth interpolation in the Bevy app
- `brp extras scroll-mouse` — Scroll the mouse wheel in the Bevy app
- `brp extras list-agent-tools` — List the agent tools published by the Bevy app

### Debug — `reference/debug.md`

- `brp debug observe` — Query components for all entities and diff against the previous snapshot
- `brp debug nl-query` — Run a natural-language query as a BRP world.query with post-filtering
- `brp debug experiment` — Drive the undo/redo experiment session
- `brp debug hypothesis` — Rerun setup ops + an assertion and report pass-rate statistics
- `brp debug record` — Control journal recording of world mutations
- `brp debug replay` — Replay the current in-memory or saved journal
- `brp debug checkpoint` — Capture or restore a world snapshot checkpoint
- `brp debug anomaly` — Query components and scan for anomalies
- `brp debug stress` — Run a stress scenario and report per-op latency stats
